verdict.rationale: Fireflies' own materials list Zoom, Google Meet, and Teams support. Its bot (fred@fireflies.ai) can be invited to a live meeting or auto-join calendar meetings to record, which gives users some choice about which meetings get recorded. Google Meet auto-recording is called out specifically, but reliability across all three platforms and fine-grained recording controls are not shown. Missing for 10: per-platform documentation for Zoom and Teams capture, explicit user controls for choosing which meetings are recorded beyond invite versus auto-join, and independent or hands-on evidence of capture reliability.

support.subject: As a product manager, the notetaker reliably captures Zoom, Google Meet, and Microsoft Teams meetings, with recording where I want it

citations.quote: Invite fred@fireflies.ai to a live meeting or have it autojoin your calendar meetings to record, transcribe, and summarize.
Automatically record your Google Meet calls and get real-time transcripts.
